subject: price list?
body:
Hi Marieke,

Could you send me the price list for 2027 when you have it? We're redoing our menu prices in November and I'd like to know if the oat milk and the coffee are going up.

Also is there a discount if we take 10 cases of oat at once? We have more space in the back now.

Thanks!
Dewi
Studio Pandan
